Reading these samples
karta_pod_workload_info: value 1 attaches workload, Component, Component Instance and Replica Group labels to a Pod.
karta_workload_status: phase-match samples; phases can overlap.
karta_exporter_observation_healthy: observation health, separate from application readiness.
workload_gpu_observer_*: direct gauges from the separate GPU observer. Utilization is a ratio (0.8 means 80%); low-activity evidence is in seconds. Empty results mean no matching series, not zero activity. Raw samples are not freshness-gated: use the workload overview for validated activity decisions. GPU measurements come directly from the cluster's NVIDIA DCGM exporter; original source labels remain visible.
DCGM_FI_DEV_*: values emitted by NVIDIA DCGM Exporter reading physical A100 GPUs. GPU utilization is a percentage (0-100); framebuffer memory is MiB. Device allocation and Pod UID labels come from kubelet. These are hardware measurements.
